items.headline: Coastal Flood Warning issued November 24 at 4:31AM PST until November 27 at 1:00PM PST by NWS San Diego CA
items.description:
* WHAT...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, minor coastal flooding.
For the Coastal Flood Warning, significant coastal flooding
expected.

* WHERE...Orange County Coastal Areas.

* WHEN...For the Coastal Flood Advisory, until 4 AM PST this
morning. For the Coastal Flood Warning, from 4 AM this morning
to 1 PM PST Friday. Most susceptible time of flooding will be
around the time of the morning high tide, with peak tides
trending from 7 AM today to 10 AM on Friday.

* IMPACTS...Numerous roads may be closed. Low lying property
including homes, businesses, and some critical infrastructure
will be inundated. Some shoreline erosion will occur.

* ADDITIONAL DETAILS...King tides peak through Wednesday at 7.9-
8.3 feet, likely breaking the all-time tidal records set back
in late October. Background surf on top of the tides will
remain around 2-5 feet through Wednesday, but a long period
west swell arriving late Wednesday will bring larger surf by
Thursday morning's high tide. Breaking waves may reach 4-6
feet with local sets up to 7-8 feet on west-facing beaches.
Surf lowers to 3- 5 feet by Friday morning's high tide.
items.instruction:
Take the necessary actions to protect flood-prone property. If
travel is required, do not drive around barricades or through
water of unknown depth.
